title: 第8章 秒胜第9章 一次不够就两次，两次不够……
content_zh:
第八章 秒胜 求会员点击推荐票
乾劲疑惑的打量着鲁迪，心中也是暗暗猜想，难道这个鲁迪故意想要输一把？还是他想要戏耍一下，故意自陷危局，然后一点点将优势拉过去，表现自己真正蛮力的一面？
两人都在好奇之时，罗林已经将紧紧握在一起的手摆到了最公正位置，突然松开两人的手掌喝道：“开始……”
桌子顿时发出一声干脆的硬物撞击声，强横的冲力振动力，令整张桌子在一瞬间弹离起了地面。
房间中所有人都呆呆的看着眼前这惊人的一幕，在罗林喊出【开始】后的那一刹那，乾劲的手臂一个突然爆发力量，直接将蛮牛鲁迪的手背，狠狠的砸在了桌面上。
乾劲……赢了……。
乾劲不但赢了，而且赢得无比干脆利落，蛮牛鲁迪甚至连反应的时间都没有，就被乾劲一瞬间给干掉了。
胜负分出的太快了，快到众人全部都愣在了当场，无法接受这眼前发生的事实。
鲁迪是谁啊？奥克莱学院战士系一年级力量第三名！仅次于那两名拥有六分之一野蛮人血统的战士的蛮力型人物。
就算是战士系二年级的学长们，同鲁迪单纯比拼蛮力，都有很多人不是他的对手。
一年二班的人，齐刷刷看着乾劲，每个人都在奇怪，这一年一班在级部单纯蛮力勉强可以排进前五十名的家伙，怎么可能掰腕子赢过鲁迪？
一切发生的都太快了，乾劲呆呆的望着自己那将蛮牛鲁迪压倒的手臂，搞不清楚刚刚发生了什么，怎么突然一个发力就把蛮牛鲁迪给击败了，就像是击败罗林一样简单轻松的事情。
乾劲甚至怀疑自己是不是在做梦，这次赢得实在是太不真实了，蛮牛掰腕子竟然瞬间就败在了自己手中。
校舍房间一时安静的掉根针在地上都能听到声音，罗林也呆呆的望着桌面的胜负情况傻掉了，他只是想要找一个比试时，输的不要太过凄惨的人而已，却怎么也想不到乾劲真的可以赢。
众人被这场面惊的甚至忘记了呼吸，所有人还在震惊之时，罗林那稍微有些肥胖的身体突然抖动了一下，紧接着……
罗林那胖胖的三角眼第一个闪现出了兴奋的光芒，他的身体犹如一头野猪扑向灌木一样，身体直接趴在了乾劲比试掰腕子的桌面上，双手贪婪的将四周其他人押的同伴向怀中揽去。
乾劲被罗林这突然的动作给吓了一跳，看着这位正在努力收钱朋友的样子，终于确定自己并不是在做梦，罗林这个出身商人家庭的家伙，对金钱有着异常的执着跟贪婪。
乾劲对罗林在金钱方面执着感到最震撼的一次，是两人在散步的时候，罗林突然停止了脚步，非说闻到了金钱的味道，这里应该有人掉落了钱财。
经过长达数分钟时间的搜索，罗林最后在草丛中找到了一个铜币。
“哈哈赚到了，赚到了。”罗林伸出十根肥胖的手指快速敛财，语气中依然带着深深的意外：“赢了，竟然真的赢了，想不到啊。”

桌面上的铜钱，转眼间全部进入了罗林的钱袋，乾劲斜了他一眼也不着急去找，刚刚有多少枚铜钱已经记得很清楚，这胖子如果敢说话不算，想要独吞，那就等着被揍成猪头吧。
“我竟然输了？这怎么可能？”蛮牛鲁迪满脸诧异，看着乾劲粗声粗气的说道：“这不可能！刚刚一定是我走神了！再来一次！”
乾劲没有去管鲁迪，而是认真看着刚刚掰腕子取胜的右手，五指全力张开突然用力握紧，房间中连响三声握拳时骨骼的脆响，一股真实，这可以触摸到的力量，随着酸痛的肌肉隐隐跳动着。
力量……乾劲轻轻皱起眉头，身为一名战士的基本素质，就是应该可以感觉出自己的能力是否有变强发生。
之前因为长相犯罪的丢人事件发生，乾劲多少有些心不在焉，即便有些怀疑自己的力量增强，却也没有认真去对待，只认为自己那个梦如果是真的，实在是太不可思议了。
掰腕子赢了年纪第三的蛮牛鲁迪，乾劲不得不认真测试一下自己的力量，结果这一握之下顿时感觉到肌肉虽然酸疼，但力量却真是澎湃不止，比以前强大了不知道多少。
乾劲松开握紧的拳头轻轻摸着鼻尖认真思考，小声自言自语：“难道，那个什么无尽世界的虚拟游戏是真的吗？真的可以锻炼我的肉体？增强我的力量？”
乾劲晃动着手腕跟五指，力量的确真实的存在，即便有些战士学员没有能力测试自己是否实力提升，但身为乾家的子弟，即便是血脉苏醒仪式上失败子弟的自己，也一样可以自我测试力量是否有增长，战士斗气是否有提升。
“喂！”蛮牛粗犷的声音打断了乾劲的沉思：“小子，再来一盘！这次我一定可以赢你。”
“还来？”乾劲确定了力量增长这个事实，表情也变得轻松起来，左右打量着房间其他人：“你们还赌吗？”
房间中的众人看着表情略带嚣张的乾劲，都有一种想要冲上去揍他一顿的冲动，只可惜学校一来是禁止私斗，而来房间里还真没人可以一对一收拾他，就算大家一起上，在乾劲倒地不起之前，也会拉足了垫背的。
乾劲的能打，那是一年级所有学员公认的前十实力，虽然他没有像其他前九名的战士一样，相互比试来定出准确的实力排名，但依然没有人会认为他实战的水准会在前十之外。
至于乾劲到底有多能打，如果硬要在级部里排名，是排在第十名的排位，还是能够排到第一，这恐怕真的只有他下场打过才知道，可惜这个孤身一人前来上学的乾劲，好像并没有跟其他战士学员一样争夺排名的心情。

Chapter 8: Win in seconds. Members please click on the recommendation ticket.
Ganjin looked at Rudy suspiciously, and secretly wondered in his heart, did this Rudy deliberately want to lose? Or does he want to play a trick, deliberately put himself in a dangerous situation, and then gradually gain the advantage and show his true brute force?
When both of them were curious, Luo Lin had already moved his tightly held hands to the most impartial position, suddenly released their palms and shouted: "Start..."
The table suddenly made a sharp impact with a hard object, and the strong momentum and vibration caused the entire table to bounce off the ground in an instant.
Everyone in the room stared blankly at the astonishing scene in front of them. The moment after Luo Lin shouted "Start", Gan Zheng's arm suddenly burst out with force, directly slamming the back of Bull Rudy's hand onto the table.
Motivation… wins….
Not only did Ganjin win, but he also won so neatly that Rudy the Bull didn't even have time to react and was killed by Ganjin in an instant.
The winner was decided so quickly that everyone was stunned on the spot, unable to accept the fact that was happening before their eyes.
Who is Rudy? Third place in the first-year strength of Oakley College Warrior Department! A brute force figure second only to the two warriors who were one-sixth barbarian.
Even among the second-year seniors in the warrior department, there are many who are no match for Rudy in a simple competition of brute force.
The people in the second class of the first year all looked at their enthusiasm. Everyone was wondering, how could the guy in the first class of this year who could barely rank in the top fifty in the class through sheer brute strength beat Rudy in a fistfight?
Everything happened too fast. Gan Jin stared blankly at his arm that had pushed down Rudy the Bull. He couldn't figure out what had just happened. How could he suddenly defeat Rudy the Bull with just one move? It was as simple and easy as defeating Luo Lin.
Gan Jin even wondered if he was dreaming. This win was so unreal. The bully was defeated in an instant by his own hands.
The school room was so quiet that you could hear the sound of a pin dropping on the ground. Luo Lin stared blankly at the outcome on the table, dumbfounded. He just wanted to find someone who wouldn't lose too miserably during the competition, but he never imagined that he could really win with motivation.
Everyone was so shocked by this scene that they even forgot to breathe. While everyone was still shocked, Luo Lin's slightly fat body suddenly shook, and then...
Luo Lin's fat triangular eyes were the first to flash with excitement. His body was like a wild boar rushing towards the bushes, and he lay directly on the table of the arm wrestling competition. His hands greedily took his companions who were surrounded by others into his arms.
Ganjin was startled by Luo Lin's sudden action. Looking at his friend who was working hard to collect money, he finally confirmed that he was not dreaming. Luo Lin, a guy from a businessman family, was extremely persistent and greedy for money.
Ganjin was most shocked by Luo Lin's persistence in money. When the two were walking, Luo Lin suddenly stopped. If he smelled money, someone must have dropped money here.
After several minutes of searching, Luo Lin finally found a copper coin in the grass.
"Haha, I made it, I made it." Luo Lin stretched out ten fat fingers to collect money quickly, and his tone was still full of surprise: "I won, I actually won, I didn't expect it."
All the copper coins on the table went into Luo Lin's wallet in the blink of an eye. He glanced at him energetically and didn't rush to find them. He already remembered clearly how many coins he had just now. If this fat man dared to say something and wanted to keep it all for himself, then he would be beaten into a pig's head.
"I actually lost? How is this possible?" Rudy, the bull, looked at him with surprise. He looked at Ganjin and said in a rough voice: "This is impossible! I must have been distracted just now.! Do it again! "
Ganjin ignored Rudy, but looked seriously at the right hand that had just won the arm-wrestle. The five fingers were spread with all their strength and suddenly clenched hard. The crisp sound of the bones as he clenched his fist three times in succession, a real and tangible power, was beating faintly with the sore muscles.
Strength... Motivation frowned slightly. The basic quality of a warrior is that he should be able to feel whether his ability has become stronger.
Due to the embarrassing incident of criminal appearance, my motivation was somewhat absent-minded. Even though I had some doubts about my increased strength, I didn't take it seriously. I just thought that if my dream was true, it would be incredible.
After defeating Rudy, the third-oldest bull, in an arm wrestling match, I had to test my strength seriously. As a result, I immediately felt my muscles were sore with this grip, but my strength was really surging. I don't know how much stronger than before.
Gan Jin loosened his clenched fist and gently touched the tip of his nose, thinking seriously, and whispered to himself: "Could it be that the virtual game of the endless world is real? Can I really exercise my body? Increase my power? "
Ganjin shook his wrist and five fingers, and the power did indeed exist. Even if some warrior students were not able to test whether their strength had improved, as a disciple of the Qian family, even if they failed in the bloodline awakening ceremony, they could still test themselves whether their strength had increased and whether their warrior fighting spirit had improved.
"Hey! "Man Niu's rough voice interrupted his energetic contemplation: "Boy, let's play again! I can definitely beat you this time. "
"Come again? "Gan Jin confirmed the fact that his strength had increased, and his expression became relaxed. He looked around at the other people in the room: "Are you still betting? ”
